ORDINANCE III OF 1978
BALUCHISTAN LOCAL GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1978
An
Ordinance to further amend the Baluchistan Government Act, 1975.
[Gazette of Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 5th February, 1978]
No. Legis
2-30/Law/75.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Baluchistan on
the 29th January, 1978 is hereby published for general information.
1. Short title, extent and commencement.--
(1) This Ordinance may be called the Baluchistan Local Government (Amendment)
Oadinance, 1978.
(2) It
extends to the whole of the Province of Baluchistan except Tribal Areas.
(3) It shall
come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect from the 12th
December 1975.

Amendment to section 4 of the Baluchistan Local Government Act, 1975 (Act No. XII of 1973)
